跟踪绳上的红色标记、原地起蹲的学生和往复移动的弹簧圈，比较横波与纵波的状态传播。: Track a rope marker, students standing in place and oscillating spring coils to compare transverse and longitudinal propagation.
运动状态向前，介质局部往复: The pattern travels; the medium oscillates locally
软绳上的红色标记: A red marker on a soft rope
光滑平面上的软弹簧: A soft spring on a smooth surface
跟踪绳、学生和弹簧圈的局部运动与传播状态: Track local motion and propagating states in a rope, people and spring coils
标记没有沿绳移动: The marker stays along the rope
绳和弹簧使用同一振源历史延迟x/v后的行波解，速度示例为2米每秒，只观察边界反射: The rope and spring use a travelling solution equal to source history delayed by x/v, with example speed 2 m/s, before boundary reflections return. The rope uses a small-slope transverse approximation with magnified vertical displacement. Spring geometry derives from axial displacement, with positive pitch. The human wave illustrates delayed actions at fixed positions, not a mechanical model of people as an elastic rope.
一个凸起向前传播，红色标记只上下运动。: A raised pulse travels while the red marker moves vertically.
向下的位移也向前传播，波的方向不随上下改变。: A downward displacement also travels forward.
连续振动形成波列: Continuous driving makes a wave train
后面的绳段重复前面的动作，但开始得更晚。: Each later segment repeats the source motion after a delay.
相邻同学稍迟重复动作，形成移动的人浪。: Delayed standing and crouching form a travelling human wave.
红衣同学没有沿队列走动，传播的是动作状态。: The highlighted student stays in place while the action pattern travels.
沿弹簧轴向推拉: Push and pull along the spring
疏密交替向前传播，弹簧圈沿轴线往复。: Compressions and rarefactions travel while coils oscillate along the axis.
放大的红色标记往复回到原位，并不随密部迁移。: The magnified marker oscillates around its original position, rather than following a compression.
温度的变化，揭示了怎样的能量过程？: What energy processes do temperature changes reveal?
从电阻量热、热鸡蛋冷却到铁块发光，分别追踪电热、能量转移与辐射光谱。: Track resistive heating, egg cooling and glowing iron through distinct calorimetry, energy-transfer and radiation apparatus.
两套相同的水量热器、电阻丝、温度计和独立直流供电: Two identical water calorimeters with resistors, thermometers and independent DC supplies
现代量热示意，用于解释焦耳定律；不复原历史仪器: Modern calorimetry illustrates Joule’s law; it does not reconstruct historical apparatus
热鸡蛋浸在冷水中，两个温度随能量交换趋同: A hot egg immersed in cold water approaches the same temperature through energy exchange
同温时没有净传热，也不会自发重新分成冷热两部分: Equal temperatures give no net heat transfer or spontaneous hot–cold separation
鸡蛋降温所失的能量，等于水升温所获的能量: Energy lost by the cooling egg equals energy gained by the warming water
炉膛内铁块随温度升高发光，下方光谱显示波长分布: Iron glows as its temperature rises; the spectrum below shows wavelength distribution
按峰值归一化的热辐射光谱，可见区以浅色标示: Thermal spectrum normalized to its peak, with the visible band shaded
横轴波长 µm；曲线各自归一化，只比较形状。屏幕亮色是曝光示意。: Horizontal axis: wavelength in µm. Curves are separately normalized for shape comparison. Bright display colors illustrate exposure.
电流相同，比较不同电阻产生的热量: At equal current, compare heat from different resistances
电阻相同，电流加倍使发热变为四倍: At fixed resistance, doubling current gives four times the heating
能量守恒，还需要过程方向的条件: Energy conservation also needs a direction-of-process condition
热鸡蛋把能量传给冷水: The hot egg transfers energy to cold water
没有可见辉光，不代表没有热辐射: No visible glow does not mean no thermal radiation
三个装置的计算边界: Limits of the three apparatus models
量热器用相同热容量和环境散热系数，电热 Q = I²Rt 与储能、散热守恒。鸡蛋: Both calorimeters share heat capacity and environmental conductance; Q = I²Rt equals stored energy plus losses. Egg and water each have uniform temperature and exchange energy, neglecting the cup and environment; real eggs have internal gradients. Iron uses an emissivity-0.8 greybody Planck spectrum below its melting point. Color and glow illustrate fixed display exposure, not calibrated real color. Furnace temperature is prescribed, not a heating-dynamics simulation.
分别改变电流和电阻，比较同时间发热: Vary current and resistance separately; compare heating over equal time
相同电阻、相同时间，比较四倍发热。: Same resistance and time: compare four times the heating.
保持电流相同，热量与电阻成正比。: At equal current, heating is proportional to resistance.
热鸡蛋放入冷水: A hot egg enters cold water
鸡蛋降温、水升温，共同趋于平衡。: The egg cools and the water warms toward equilibrium.
能量守恒并不保证任意过程都能自发发生。: Energy conservation does not make every process spontaneous.
室温辐射以红外为主。: Room-temperature thermal radiation is mainly infrared.
可见占比继续增加，屏幕颜色不是温度计。: Visible fraction rises; screen color is not a thermometer.
放电之后，远处为什么有了响应？: Why does a distant receiver respond after a discharge?
保留教材的平行铜管天线，追踪发射波包、传播延迟、距离变化与接收检波。: Follow a finite RF packet through the textbook’s parallel copper-tube antennas, propagation delay, distance changes and detection.
发射变化先发生，接收响应要等待传播: Emission happens first; reception waits for propagation
对齐同一脉冲时刻，距离越远响应越弱: Compare the same packet phase: greater distance weakens reception
源停止放电后，已发出的波仍继续传播: After emission stops, the outgoing wave keeps traveling
改变距离或观察时刻，追踪同一个发射脉冲: Change distance or observation time to follow one emitted packet
两组平行铜管组成发射和接收天线，接收表含整流检波示意: Parallel copper-tube pairs transmit and receive; the receiver assumes RF detection
时间放慢；铜管与间距分别放大。场线段显示极性与到达，不按真实振幅缩放。: Time is slowed and antenna size and spacing magnified separately. Field strokes show polarity and arrival, not true amplitude to scale.
教材没有给出电流表内部结构。这里用平方律检波与平滑响应解释相对示数，不能把裸直流: The textbook does not specify the meter internals. Square-law detection and smoothing explain the relative indication; a bare DC meter cannot directly read high-frequency AC this way. Parallel antennas are compared only in an ideal radiative far field, with E proportional to1/r and detected response to1/r². Near fields, reflections, multipath, frequency response and detuning are omitted. A finite illustrative RF packet represents the spark; this is not a reconstruction of Hertz’s historical apparatus.
对齐同一波包阶段，再比较响应。: Align the packet phase before comparing response.
在途电磁波继续前进，接收响应随后衰减。: The wave continues in transit; the detected response then decays.
耗电不同，怎样判断是哪一个因素造成的？: How can we identify which factor changed energy use?
用同一模型手机设计亮度、音量、任务与网络的对照，记录合成数据并识别混杂因素。: Design brightness, volume, task and network comparisons on one model phone; record synthetic data and identify confounds.
只改变屏幕亮度，保持内容与时间相同: Change only brightness, keeping content and duration equal
音量对照需要相同的有声内容: Volume comparisons need the same audible content
比较应用任务时，固定亮度、音量和网络条件: Compare tasks at fixed brightness, volume and network conditions
亮度和网络同时改变，差异不能只归因于亮度: Changing brightness and network together prevents a brightness-only conclusion
先检查改变了几个因素，再解释能量差: Count changed factors before explaining the energy difference
合成教学数据 · 不代表任何实际手机: Synthetic teaching data · Not measurements of a real phone
同一部模型手机的组件分解：屏幕、处理器、无线电、扬声器和电池: Component decomposition of one model phone: display, processor, radio, speaker and battery
依次为亮度、音量、网络负载倍率；同一手机、同一时长: Brightness, volume and network-load multiplier; same phone and duration
从演示转成真实研究: From demonstration to a real study
本片功率档案全部为合成教学参数，应用任务不是实测耗电排名。真实研究应固定同一设备: Power profiles are synthetic teaching parameters, not a measured ranking of applications. A real study should control device, content, duration, network and initial state, change one factor per comparison, and repeat measurements. Energy integrates power over time. Integer battery percentages can hide small differences and are not precise energy measurements. Processor and radio use illustrative periodic loads; assumed capacity is15 Wh. The component layout is not a specific phone teardown.
相同内容与时间，分开比较一个因素。: Hold content and duration fixed to isolate one factor.
有声内容保持相同，才是音量对照。: Keep audible content identical for a volume comparison.
固定设置与时长，再观察任务差异。: Fix settings and duration before comparing tasks.
同时改变多个条件，就不能做单一归因。: Multiple changed conditions prevent a single-factor conclusion.
是什么力让物体不断转弯？: Which force keeps an object turning?
剪绳、旋转沙袋、双球向心力演示器与玻璃漏斗，从不同装置辨认向心合力并控制变量。: Use string release, a rotating bag, a two-ball demonstrator and a glass funnel to identify radial resultants and isolate variables.
向心合力 · 控制变量 · 测力: Radial resultant · Controlled variables · Force measurement
变速塔轮带动两个旋转槽，球压挡板，经杠杆拉动弹簧测力套筒: Stepped pulleys drive two rotating channels; ball pressure acts through levers on spring sleeves
剪断绳子，球沿切线离开: Cut the string and the ball departs tangentially
手感受到的是绳张力，它还要托住重力: The hand feels tension, which must also support weight
漏斗壁的支持力与重力合成向心力: Funnel support and gravity combine into the radial resultant
只改变质量，比较两球向心力: Change only mass and compare radial forces
角速度相同，改变轨道半径: Keep angular speed fixed and change orbital radius
角速度加倍，向心力怎样变化？: What happens to force when angular speed doubles?
先看清挡板、杠杆与测力套筒的传力路径: First follow force through the stop, lever and spring sleeve
水平圆周 · 绳子实际倾斜: Horizontal circle · The string is inclined
光滑桌面圆周运动的小球在剪断绳后沿切线运动: A ball on a smooth table follows its tangent after string release
倾斜绳悬挂的沙袋沿水平圆周转动，张力有向上与向心分量: A bag on an inclined string circles horizontally; tension has vertical and inward components
小球在透明漏斗内作水平圆周运动，斜向支持力与重力的合力水平向内: A ball orbits inside a transparent funnel; oblique support plus gravity gives a horizontal inward resultant
拉力消失后保留瞬时速度；向心力不是把球向外甩的力。: After tension disappears, instantaneous velocity remains; centripetal force does not throw the ball outward.
张力的竖直分量平衡重力，水平分量才提供向心力。: Vertical tension balances gravity; only its horizontal component supplies centripetal force.
向心力是合力的作用效果，不是在重力和支持力之外再增加一个力。: Centripetal force names the resultant’s effect, not an extra force added to gravity and support.
一次只改变一个量，标尺经杠杆与弹簧校准后比较作用力。: Change one variable at a time and compare forces after lever–spring calibration.
仪器按传力路径重建，刚性杠杆与滑动接头保持连接；套筒按弹簧与力矩平衡校准，不冒充: The apparatus reconstructs the force path with rigid levers and sliding clevises; sleeves are calibrated by spring and torque balance, not presented as dimensions of a specific commercial model.
水平圆周为理想稳态，忽略空气阻力和摩擦；沙袋绳倾角与漏斗角速度由受力条件求得。: Horizontal orbits are ideal steady states without air drag or friction; bag inclination and funnel angular speed follow force balance.
剪绳看离开方向: Cut the string and observe departure
拉力消失，瞬时速度沿切线保留下来。: Tension vanishes while tangent velocity remains.
辨认手感中的张力: Identify the tension felt by the hand
张力还有竖直分量，不能完全当成向心力。: Tension also has a vertical component and is not entirely centripetal.
球压挡板，经杠杆改变测力套筒位置。: Ball pressure moves a spring sleeve through a lever.
同半径、同角速度，质量加倍使力加倍。: At fixed radius and angular speed, doubling mass doubles force.
同质量、同角速度，半径加倍使力加倍。: At fixed mass and angular speed, doubling radius doubles force.
塔轮使角速度加倍，向心力变为四倍。: A pulley change doubles angular speed and quadruples force.
漏斗里是谁推球转弯: What turns the ball inside a funnel?
斜向支持力与竖直重力同时存在。: Oblique support and vertical gravity act together.
竖直分量抵消，水平向内分量留下。: Vertical components cancel, leaving the inward horizontal part.
为什么拉紧一根绳，就能画出椭圆？: Why does a taut thread trace an ellipse?
两枚图钉、一根不可伸长的细绳和一支铅笔，观察距离和不变与焦点靠近时的形状变化。: Two pins, an inextensible thread and a pencil reveal a constant distance sum and how approaching foci reshape the curve.
绳长不变，让两个焦点靠近: Keep thread length fixed and bring the foci closer
两端分别系在图钉上，铅笔始终绷紧细绳: Pin the two ends separately and keep the thread taut
木板上的两枚图钉系住细绳两端，铅笔撑紧细绳并画出椭圆: Two pins hold the thread ends on a board; a pencil keeps it taut and traces an ellipse
焦点重合，椭圆成为圆；半长轴就是圆半径。: Coincident foci give a circle; the semimajor axis becomes its radius.
焦点靠近，短轴变长；长轴始终等于绳长。: Closer foci increase the minor axis; the major axis stays equal to thread length.
两段长度此消彼长，总和始终不变。: One segment lengthens as the other shortens; their sum stays fixed.
铅笔和图钉按点处理，细绳不可伸长。绘图速度不代表行星沿轨道运行的速度。: Pins and pencil are ideal points and the thread does not stretch. Drawing speed does not represent planetary orbital speed.
绳长必须大于两个图钉的距离。: Thread length must exceed pin separation.
一段变长，另一段相应变短。: As one segment grows, the other shortens.
到两焦点距离之和不变，形成椭圆。: A constant sum of distances to two foci traces an ellipse.
保持绳长，焦点重合时得到圆。: With fixed thread length, coincident foci give a circle.
减少的重力势能，都变成动能了吗？: Does every loss of gravitational energy become kinetic energy?
从纸带、光电门与气垫导轨出发，独立测量高度和速度，并正确选择研究系统。: Use tape, photogates and air tracks to obtain height and speed independently and define the measured system correctly.
水平气垫导轨、滑块、定滑轮与悬挂砝码组成同一系统: Horizontal air track, slider, fixed pulley and hanging masses form one system
倾斜气垫导轨上的滑块依次穿过两个光电门: A slider on an inclined air track passes through two photogates
从纸带位置，独立求出速度和高度: Obtain speed and height independently from tape positions
用两道光电门测量下滑前后: Measure before and after descent with two photogates
悬挂物失去的势能，去了哪里？: Where does the hanging load’s lost potential energy go?
把摆动作为另一种实验方案: Consider a pendulum as another experimental design
模型生成的示例读数 · 不是实测数据: Model-generated example readings · Not recorded data
等时纸带点按实际位移分布，分别选取两组相邻三点测速度: Equal-time dots follow computed positions; two neighboring triplets provide velocities
重物带着纸带穿过固定的打点计时器，下落位置按等时间隔留下墨点: A falling load pulls tape through a fixed timer, recording positions at equal time intervals
小球绕固定支点摆动，绳长固定，动能与势能从独立运动方程计算: A bob swings on a fixed-length string; energy is calculated from independently integrated motion
阻力做负功：减少的重力势能，不再全部变为动能。: Resistance does negative work: gravitational energy loss no longer all becomes kinetic energy.
纸带同时提供高度差与速度；两种能量从各自测量量计算。: Tape provides height difference and velocities; each energy is calculated from its own measured quantities.
挡光宽度除以挡光时间，给出过门期间的平均速度。: Flag width divided by blocking time gives mean speed during gate passage.
系统包括滑块、遮光条、托盘和砝码；两部分都有动能。: The system includes slider, flag, tray and masses; both moving parts have kinetic energy.
摆动方案：张力与瞬时位移垂直，不做功；仍需实际测量高度和速度。: Pendulum proposal: tension is perpendicular to displacement and does no work; height and speed still need real measurements.
只算滑块会漏掉悬挂物动能: Counting only the slider misses the hanging load’s kinetic energy
纸带忽略打点扰动；气轨忽略转动惯量。有限遮光宽度带来小的速度近似误差，可在探索中: Tape ignores marking disturbances and the air-track model omits rotational inertia. Finite flag width causes a small speed approximation error; change width in exploration to inspect it.
先通电，再释放；等时间隔打点。: Start the timer before release; dots mark equal time intervals.
中间时刻速度等于前后两点间平均速度。: Middle-time speed equals the average across its two neighboring dots.
阻力使机械能减少，不把差值强行归零。: Resistance removes mechanical energy; do not force the difference to zero.
让空气层减小阻力: Reduce resistance with an air layer
滑块和遮光条一起沿倾斜气轨运动。: The slider and flag move together along the inclined air track.
d/Δt 是过门平均速度，窄条才近似瞬时速度。: d/Δt is a passage average; a narrow flag approximates instantaneous speed.
滑块与悬挂物通过同一根不可伸长的绳相连。: Slider and hanging load share one inextensible cord.
势能看悬挂质量；动能看全部运动质量。: Potential loss uses hanging mass; kinetic gain uses all moving mass.
把摆动保留为可检验方案: Keep the pendulum as a testable proposal
理想摆动说明条件，实际验证仍需测量。: An ideal pendulum illustrates conditions; verification still requires measurement.
水波槽中的传播与叠加: Propagation and superposition in a ripple tank
同一片水面，为什么会出现不同的波纹？: Why does the same water surface form different wave patterns?
从漂浮纸屑到反射、折射、衍射、双源干涉与移动波源，逐一更换真实器材观察水波。: Change real apparatus to observe floating paper, reflection, refraction, diffraction, interference and a moving ripple source.
不同水波实验的真实挡板、浅水板、振源与漂浮纸屑: Barriers, a shallow-water plate, sources and floating paper in distinct water-wave experiments
静止振源发出同心波峰: A still source makes concentric crests
M、N是固定观察位置: M and N are fixed probes
波场颜色不可用，仍可查看装置与正文。: Wave-field colour is unavailable; the apparatus and article remain accessible.
纸屑相对原位: Paper relative to its mean position
水槽采用线性重力波与长波近似，常规基准水深8毫米，衍射采用1毫米浅水，速度为√g: Linear gravity-wave and long-wave approximations use an 8 mm reference depth, or 1 mm for diffraction, with speed √gh. Viscosity, surface tension and tank-edge echoes are omitted. Reflection and refraction match boundary conditions. An aperture-wavelet integral models diffraction direction, without precise near-gap or absolute-amplitude predictions. Colour shows instantaneous height, not flow or energy. Paper motion uses a small-amplitude approximation with magnified side-view height; moving-source crests retain their emission centres.
波纹向外，纸屑在原位附近运动。: Ripples travel outward while paper moves near its mean position.
振源不断产生波纹，纸屑仍只作局部运动。: Repeated waves do not carry the paper along with each crest.
反射改变传播方向，入射角等于反射角。: Reflection changes direction, with equal incident and reflected angles.
入射方向改变，反射方向按相同角度响应。: The reflected direction responds by the same angle.
频率不变，波速和波长减小，传播方向偏折。: Frequency stays fixed while speed, wavelength and direction change.
深度差越小，方向和波长的变化也越小。: Smaller depth contrast produces smaller changes in direction and wavelength.
固定波长，改变狭缝: Vary the gap at fixed wavelength
狭缝与波长接近时，缝后的展开更明显。: Spreading becomes more pronounced when gap width approaches wavelength.
决定明显程度的是缝宽与波长的相对大小。: Relative gap width and wavelength determine the visible spreading.
固定相位差的双源形成稳定强弱区。: A fixed phase relationship creates stable reinforcement and cancellation regions.
改变相位会移动强弱区；频率不同则不再保持稳定图样。: Changing phase moves the pattern; different frequencies prevent a fixed pattern.
相同周期发出的波峰有相同的圆心。: Crests emitted periodically by a still source share a centre.
前方波峰更密，后方波峰更疏。: Crests are closer ahead and farther apart behind.
同样停下来，为什么感觉到的力不同？: Why can stopping produce different forces?
比较充气与放气气球，再分开车辆和理想乘员的停止过程。: Compare inflated and deflated balloons, then separate a vehicle stop from an ideal occupant response.
封闭空气也随气球运动，不能只算乳胶质量。: Enclosed air moves with the balloon and contributes inertia.
放气后，用相同速度比较: Compare the deflated balloon at equal speed
减少质量会减少需要改变的动量。: Less mass means a smaller momentum change to stop.
保持动量变化，延长停止时间: Keep momentum change fixed and lengthen the stop
冲量相同，平均力和峰值力可以改变。: The same impulse can accompany different average and peak forces.
跟踪车辆在刚性壁障前的停止: Track a vehicle stopping at a rigid barrier
车体位移、减速度与受力来自同一停止过程。: Vehicle motion, deceleration and force follow one stopping history.

声音不可用，波峰与频率读数仍可观察。: Audio is unavailable; crests and frequency remain visible.
